query:
UPDATE user_totp
           SET last_used_step = $2,
               code_login_failed_attempts = 0,
               code_login_locked_until = NULL,
               updated_at = NOW()
           WHERE user_id = $1
             AND enabled = TRUE
             AND (code_login_locked_until IS NULL OR code_login_locked_until <= NOW())
             AND (last_used_step IS NULL OR last_used_step < $2)
